title: When High Capacity Becomes Undeployable: Pore-Filling Constraints for Multi-Objective Optimization of Direct Air Capture Sorbents
abstract: arXiv:2611.34154v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Amine-impregnated sorbents with the highest nominal CO2 capacity are frequently the least deployable, as amine beyond the pore-volume limit blocks active sites. Yet multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) for direct air capture (DAC) treats formulation search as unconstrained. We encode the pore-filling boundary as an explicit outcome constraint, c(x) = tanh(1 - phi_hat) - tau, and use it as a diagnostic instrument on a hand-curated, DOI-traceable benchmark of 618 solid-amine formulations from 43 publications. Unconstrained MOBO attains higher nominal capacity (3.639 +/- 0.815 vs. 2.964 +/- 0.728 mmol/g, p = 1.0e-11), but across 100 seeds 63.2% of its Pareto-optimal candidates violate the pore-filling boundary versus 39.3% under the constraint: it is rewarded for proposing candidates outside the pore-confined design regime. translated_title: 当高容量变得不可部署：直接空气捕集吸附剂多目标优化中的孔隙填充约束
translated_abstract: 名义CO₂容量最高的胺浸渍吸附剂往往最难实际部署，因为超出孔体积限制的胺会堵塞活性位点。然而，用于直接空气捕集（DAC）的多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）通常将配方搜索视为无约束问题。我们将孔隙填充边界编码为显式结果约束 c(x) = tanh(1 - phi_hat) - tau，并将其作为诊断工具，应用于一个手工整理、可通过DOI追溯的基准数据集，该数据集包含来自43篇出版物的618个固体胺配方。无约束MOBO获得了更高的名义容量（3.639 ± 0.815 对比 2.964 ± 0.728 mmol/g，p = 1.0e-11），但在100个随机种子中，其帕累托最优候选方案中有63.2%违反孔隙填充边界，而有约束情形下仅为39.3%：即它在提出孔隙受限设计域之外的候选方案时反而获得了奖励。该约束引导帕累托前沿趋向更低的负载量（55.8 对比 65.2 wt%）和更大的孔隙。该边界得到……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文创新性地将孔隙填充边界作为显式结果约束引入DAC吸附剂的多目标贝叶斯优化，并基于618个可追溯配方构建基准，揭示无约束优化会系统性提出物理上不可部署的高容量配方，而显式约束能将搜索引导至更低胺负载、更大孔隙的可部署设计。
en_tdlr: This work encodes the pore-filling boundary as an explicit outcome constraint in multi-objective Bayesian optimization for DAC sorbents, using a DOI-traceable benchmark of 618 solid-amine formulations to show that unconstrained MOBO is systematically rewarded for proposing physically undeployable high-capacity candidates, while the explicit constraint steers the Pareto front toward deployable designs with lower amine loadings and larger pores.
